title: The dream is killing me
content: Hello, I've just found out this page. I've been having this dream trough the last years of a woman, I've got a girlfriend the last 10 years and 2 kids. It's killing me waking up so happy about the dream. I've just woke up and had to Google whats going on and found this reddit. Lats night I've dreamt about her again, I've met her daughter and she finnaly met my kids, I didn't even knew she had a daughter 😂 (around 5 years old). This is super realist that when I wake up I still get confused. I've never met her but she look different Everytime, like clothes, makeup, hair etc. I'm so happy with her like I never been along time ago. Why is this happening! I don't get it. Thank you, finnaly found a place to share this!
